about: The Workbench icons of the LinWarrior drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/linwarrior.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a walking mech on a green hillside at dusk firing its arm cannon, a city skyline behind) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/linwarrior.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. LinWarrior-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, LinWarrior.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's LinWarrior.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, the licence files and README-LinWarrior.txt; Data.info is the icon of the data drawer.
